description:
This video examines the global supply chain of lithium, a critical component in electric vehicle batteries and renewable energy storage. It explores the distributional impacts of lithium mining, including water use, economic benefits, local jobs, and indigenous rights. The video discusses the complexities of lithium extraction, the challenges of water accounting, and the need for a fairer framework to allocate water, value, and risk. It highlights the differences in lithium mining practices between Chile and Argentina, and the importance of stakeholder dialogue, community participation, and reducing demand through material efficiency and recycling.

title: The Lithium Supply Chain: Balancing Energy Needs and Local Impacts
